A large salad with leafy greens, broccoli, shredded carrot, chicken pieces, and crumbled white cheese, likely feta.

### 2 — Vessel
A wide, shallow bowl, estimated **26 cm in diameter**.  
Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ **531 cm²**. The bowl is partly cropped, so its size is uncertain.

### 3 — Items
Leafy greens, broccoli florets, shredded carrot, chicken breast, and feta-like cheese. No distinct dressing or oil is clearly visible, so none is added.
